cues.text: Every weekend, millions of people play Fantasy Premier League.
And every one of them has an opinion.
But opinions are free.
So what happens when you put a price on them?
This is Overline. An open study, built on Panta.
For our launch week, we created three Fantasy Premier League markets, live on Panta.
We started with five frontier AI models. Each with its own wallet, five dollars, and the same live price.
They state a probability, and a reason. Then they trade.
Then we asked football fans on X to make their call, in public.
Forty seven replies. Twelve calls, recorded word for word.
Every single one said yes.
We gave six of them a free three dollar stake, placed on Panta, in a wallet with their name on it.
Then the matches were played.
Saka, at home to Leeds. Two points. The line was seven.
Haaland scored at Anfield, and still finished on six. The line was eight.
Twelve calls. Twelve misses.
The models weren't perfect. They missed João Pedro's twelve point haul against Bournemouth. But on the board, Claude, Gemini and GPT all finished in profit.
Every step runs on the Panta API. Creating the markets. Quoting the price. Building, signing, submitting, and verifying every order.
Each model signs with its own key. Panta settles against the official FPL data. Every position, fully transparent.
Overline is research first. But the audience is already on X.
Next gameweek, you reply with your call, and it becomes your own position on Panta.
Then, betting straight from X, with X Money.
Every gameweek. More models. More players. More leagues. Every call, on the record.
Opinions are free. Conviction has a price.
Overline. Built on Panta.
